import axios_api from"./axios";import{BASE_URL}from"./config";const host="/buyer/partorder";// 전체 발주 조회
export const getPartOrders=async()=>{const res=await axios_api.get(host);return res.data;};// 완료된 발주 리스트
export const getCompletedPartOrders=async()=>{const{data}=await axios_api.get("".concat(host,"/completed"));return data;};// 등록
export const createPartOrder=async formData=>{const res=await axios_api.post(host,formData);return res.data;};// 수정
export const updatePartOrder=async(poNo,formData)=>{const res=await axios_api.put("".concat(host,"/").concat(poNo),formData);return res.data;};// 상태 패치
export const patchPartOrderState=(poNo,poState)=>axios_api.patch("".concat(BASE_URL,"/buyer/partorder/").concat(poNo,"/state"),{poState});// 삭제
export const deletePartOrder=async poNo=>{const res=await axios_api.delete("".concat(host,"/").concat(poNo));return res.data;};
